blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multiplayer world models must generate independently controlled views with consistent representations of both players and their shared environment. Most existing approaches coordinate multiple players through joint multi-view generation, whose cost grows with each additional player. We present WorldCast, a distributed multiplayer world model in which each player runs a local client comprising a video generator and a state model. Using recorded player positions and map geometry during training, the state model estimates the player's position from generated video and control inputs. Clients exchange player states and project them into camera-aligned player state fields that guide where and how other players are rendered. Shared scene state enables clients to reuse one another's generated observations to maintain consistent scene appearance across views. Experiments on Counter-Strike 2 demonstrate WorldCast's consistency, real-time performance, and distributed scalability. The camera-aligned player state field improves player rendering rates by over an order of magnitude over joint-generation methods, while shared scene state improves visual consistency over whole rounds. Each client runs in real time and exchanges only player and scene states, enabling scalable multiplayer generation without a centralized computational bottleneck. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.
blocks.zh: 多人世界模式必须产生独立控制的观点,双方玩家及其共同环境的表述一致. 大多数现有方法通过联合多视图生成来协调多个玩家,其成本随着每个额外的玩家而增加. 我们介绍WorldCast,一个分布式多人世界模型,其中每个玩家运行一个由视频生成器和一个状态模型组成的本地客户端. 在训练期间使用记录的玩家位置和地图几何,状态模型通过生成的视频和控制输入来估计玩家的位置. 客户端交换玩家状态,并将其投射到相机对齐的玩家状态域,以指导其他玩家的提供地点和方式. 共享的场景状态使客户端能够重新使用彼此生成的观测数据,以保持场景在视图间的一致性. 反冲击2号的实验演示了世界卡斯特公司的一致性,实时性能,以及分布式的可伸缩性. 相机对齐的玩家状态场比联合生成方法提高玩家的渲染率,比数量级以上,而共享场景状态则提高整个回合的视觉一致性. 每个客户端实时运行,并只交换玩家和场景状态,使得可扩展的多人生成没有集中计算瓶颈. 图像质量在长达一小时的推出期间保持稳定。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive video world models generate an agent’s visual observations in response to its actions ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025b ; Valevski et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026a ) . Multiplayer world modeling extends this setting to several independently controlled players in a shared environment ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Savva et al., 2026 ) . When players are visible, their locations should be consistent across viewpoints; previously observed parts of the environment should also retain their appearance across views and over time. Each view should remain responsive as players are added and, ideally, be generated on its own machine. Maintaining cross-view consistency without coupling the computation of different views is the central challenge.
blocks.zh: 互动视频世界模型生成一个代理商针对其行为的视觉观察(Bruce等,2024;He等,2025b;Valevski等,2025;Huang等,2026a). 多人世界建模将这一设定扩展至多个在共享环境中独立控制的玩家(Cai等,2026;Liu等,2026;Savva等,2026). 当玩家可见时,其位置应保持不同观点的一致性;以前观察到的环境部分也应保留其不同观点和不同时间的外观. 每种观点都应随着角色的加入而保持响应性,并且最好在自己的机器上产生. 在不协调不同观点计算的情况下保持交叉观点的一致性是中心挑战。

blocks.en:
Most prior methods generate players’ views jointly through cross-view attention ( Hu et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Mo et al., 2026 ; Savva et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026a ) , increasing computation and inter-device communication as players are added.
Generating views independently avoids this coupling, but each generator then has access only to its own observations and controls. It needs additional information to place other players correctly and reproduce scene content observed from other viewpoints. A distributed approach must therefore share both spatial information about players and generated scene appearance, without requiring the views to be generated together.
blocks.zh:
多数前作方法通过交叉视角关注共同产生玩家的观点(Hu等,2026a; Hu等, 2026b; Liu等, 2026; Mo等, 2026; Savva等, 2026; Sun等, 2026a等),随着玩家的加入,增加了计算和互通.
独立生成视图可以避免这种耦合,但每个生成器随后只能访问自己的观测和控制. 它需要更多的信息来正确安置其他玩家,并从其他角度复制所观察到的场景内容. 因此,分布式方法必须分享关于玩家的空间信息并产生场景外观,而不需要同时产生观点。

blocks.en:
To provide this shared information while keeping generation independent, we propose WorldCast . Inspired by the organization of networked games ( Funkhouser, 1995 ; Bernier, 2001 ) , each player runs a client that maintains a local copy of the shared world state and generates its own view.
We represent this state with two complementary components. Player state records players’ positions and attributes, projected into a camera-aligned player state field that guides the rendering of other players. Scene state stores generated observations in a shared memory bank, supplying content missing from each client’s recent context. Clients exchange these states once per video block while keeping intermediate features local. A fixed-resolution player state field and a bounded number of retrieved scene frames allow additional players without enlarging the generator’s input.
blocks.zh:
为了提供共享信息, 在网络游戏组织(Funkhouser,1995;Bernier,2001)的启发下,每个玩家经营一个客户端,维护一个共享世界状态的本地拷贝并生成自己的取景.
我们以两个相辅相成的组成部分代表这一状况。 玩家状态记录玩家的位置和属性,投射到一个相机相接的玩家状态场来指导其他玩家的渲染. 场景状态商店在一个共享的内存库中生成了观察,提供每个客户最近上下文缺失的内容. 客户每个视频块一次交换这些状态,同时保留中间功能局部. 一个固定分辨率的播放器状态字段和被取回的相框数量可以允许额外的播放器而不扩大生成器的输入.

blocks.en: Unlike in a networked game, WorldCast has no engine supplying positions and geometry at inference. Each client therefore includes a state model , trained with recorded positions and map geometry, that estimates its own position and scene depth from generated video and controls. Position estimates correct control-based extrapolation and update player state; depth supports player visibility checks and scene memory retrieval. After each block, clients publish these updates and share the generated observations, completing the loop between generation and state estimation.
blocks.zh: 与网络游戏不同,WorldCast没有提供位置和几何推断的引擎. 因此,每个客户端都有一个状态模型,受过记录位置和地图几何训练,该模型通过生成的视频和控制来估计自己的位置和场景深度。 位置估计正确基于控制外推并更新玩家状态;深度支持玩家能见度检查和场景内存检索. 每个块后,客户端会发布这些更新并分享生成的观测结果,完成生成和状态估计之间的循环.

blocks.en:
We evaluate WorldCast on Counter-Strike 2 (Fig. 1 ).
Given the same ground-truth (GT) player positions, our camera-aligned player field achieves a player rendering rate over ten times that of the joint-generation ( Savva et al., 2026 ) and frame-concatenation baselines. This rate measures the proportion of visible players rendered at their expected positions.
Predicted player positions retain much of this rendering rate over ten-second windows (Table 2 ).
Shared scene state further improves visual consistency over whole rounds (Table 3 ).
With scene state enabled, each client generates video at over 16 FPS across deployments of 2 to 16 clients (Fig. 6 ), including decoding but excluding synchronization waits. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.

我们评价世界杯的反冲击2(图1).
鉴于地面真能(GT)玩家位置相同,我们相相机相接的玩家场实现玩家渲染率超过联合生成(Savva等,2026年)和帧相接基线的十倍. 这一比率衡量在预期位置上显眼的玩家的比例。
预测的玩家位置在十秒窗口上保留了这一渲染率的大部分(表2 ).
共享场景状态会进一步提高整个回合的视觉一致性(表3.
随着场景状态的启用,每个客户端在2至16个客户端(图6)的部署中以超过16个FPS生成视频,包括解码但不包括同步等. 图像质量在长达一小时的推出期间保持稳定。

blocks.en: We summarize our contributions as follows: 1. We propose WorldCast , a distributed multiplayer world model whose clients each generate one player’s view and share only a world state, which conditions each generator through a camera-aligned player state field and a scene memory bank. 2. We develop a state model that estimates each player’s position and scene depth from its generated video and controls, enabling clients to update the shared world state without a game engine supplying these quantities at inference. 3. We demonstrate improved player rendering and whole-round visual consistency on Counter-Strike 2. Each client generates video in real time with 2 to 16 players, and image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Multiplayer World Models. Extending single-view world models ( He et al., 2025b ; Kanervisto et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , joint-generation methods denoise all views together ( Hu et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Mo et al., 2026 ; Savva et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026a ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , so views on different machines exchange attention features at every step (Appendix B ); shared-screen methods bind each agent’s actions to its character in one frame ( Pondaven et al., 2026 ) ; shared-state methods condition views on a state advanced by actions, either centrally ( Cai et al., 2026 ) or by per-player generators on a given map ( Po et al., 2026 ) , or encoded from all views’ latest frames ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . WorldCast clients exchange only player state, estimated from generated video and controls, and scene state, a memory bank of generated blocks.
blocks.zh: 多人世界模特儿. 扩展单景世界模型(He等,2025年b;Kanervisto等,2025年;Zhang等,2026年a),联合生成方法将所有观点合并到一起(Hu等,2026年a; Hu等,2026b;Liu等,2026;Mo等,2026;Savva等,2026;Sun等,2026a;Zhu等,2026;Zhu等,2026;因此,对不同机器的看法在每个步骤上交换注意特征(附录B);共享屏幕方法将每个代理人的行为与其性格结合在一个框架内(Pondaven等,2026);共享状态方法条件观点以行动推进,无论是中央(Cai等,2026),还是在给定地图(Po等,2026)上由玩家发电机进行,或者从所有观点的最新框架中编码(Wu等,2026). 世界 铸币客户只交换玩家状态,根据生成的视频和控制估计,以及场景状态,一个生成块的内存库.

blocks.en: Controllable Video Generation. Structured conditioning provides spatial guidance for image and video generation. Object boxes can be encoded as additional tokens ( Li et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Russell et al., 2025 ) , while image-aligned control maps convey edges or depth ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , motion trajectories ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) or time-varying 3D states ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . WorldCast applies such image-aligned conditioning to incorporate the player states exchanged between clients. Its state injector projects each visible player into the local camera and places both spatial and gameplay attributes at the corresponding generator tokens.
blocks.zh: 可控视频生成. 结构配置为图像和视频生成提供空间指导. 对象箱可被编码为附加符(Li等,2023;Gao等,2024;Russell等,2025;而图像相通的控制地图会传递边缘或深度(Zhang等,2023;),运动轨迹(Wang等,2025;Zhang等,2026b)或时间变化的3D状态(Zheng等,2026.). 世界 Cast应用了这样的图像相通条件,以包含客户端之间交换的玩家状态. 它的状态注入器将每个可见的玩家投放到本地相机中,并将空间属性和游戏玩法属性都放置在相应的生成符上.

blocks.en:
Autoregressive Video Diffusion. Autoregressive video diffusion models generate video incrementally in a video autoencoder’s latent space ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) with block-causal attention ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025b ) trains on the model’s own rollouts to reduce error accumulation, and LIVE ( Huang et al., 2026b ) bounds this error to keep rollouts stable well beyond the training horizon. Distribution matching distillation ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2024b ) enables few-step generators.
To preserve scenes beyond a limited context window, memory-augmented models ( Huang et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026b ) retrieve their own past frames by field-of-view overlap, camera pose or 3D geometry. ShareVerse ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) also retrieves other agents’ frames by proximity within joint denoising.
WorldCast combines four-step autoregressive generation with a memory bank shared across independent clients, allowing clients to reuse one another’s generated content without jointly denoising their views.
blocks.zh:
自动回放视频传播. 自动回转式视频传播模型在视频自动编码器的潜在空间中逐渐生成视频(Wan等,2025;Xie等,2026),并有块-原因关注(Chen等,2024;Yin等,2025.). 自强制 (Huang等,2025b) 由该型号自行推出的列车来减少出错积累,而LIVE(Huang等,2026b)则将这一出错限制在远超训练地平线的出行稳定. 配给蒸馏(Yin等人,2024a; Yin等, 2024b) 允许几步发电机。
保存有限上下文窗口以外的场景,内存强化模型(Huang等,2025a; Li等,2025;Xiao等,2025;Yu等,2025;Nam等,2026;Sun等,2026b)通过视野重叠取回自己过去的相框,相机姿势或3D几何. ShareVerse(Zhu等人,2026年)也通过在联合解密范围内的相近距离取回了其他代理的帧.
WorldCast结合了由四步自动递归生成与独立客户共享的内存库,允许客户在不联合淡出自己观点的情况下再利用对方所生成的内容.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: WorldCast lets multiple players inhabit one generated world, kept consistent through a shared world state. This state comprises player state, which describes players’ positions and attributes, and scene state, which stores generated observations of the environment. We first introduce the distributed generation framework (Sec. 3.1 ), then describe how player state (Sec. 3.2 ) and scene state (Sec. 3.3 ) are maintained and incorporated into each generator. We next present the state model that estimates position and depth from generated video (Sec. 3.4 ), followed by training and inference (Sec. 3.5 ).
blocks.zh: WorldCast让多个玩家居住在一个创造出的世界,通过一个共享的世界状态来保持一致性. 这个状态包括玩家状态,它描述玩家的位置和属性,以及场景状态,它存储生成的环境观测. 我们首先引入了分布式生成框架(Sec. 3.1),然后描述玩家状态(Sec. 3.2)和场景状态(Sec. 3.3)是如何维持和融入每个生成器的. 接下来,我们介绍从生成的视频(第3.4节)中估计位置和深度的状态模型,然后是培训和推断(第3.5节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Distributed Generation with Shared World State
blocks.zh: 3.1 与共同世界国家分配的世代

blocks.en:
To support scalable multiplayer video generation across machines, WorldCast separates shared world state from local rendering. As in Fig. 2 (a), existing coupled designs coordinate players
through joint multi-view generation that processes players’ views together through cross-view attention or view concatenation.
WorldCast instead assigns each of the P P players an independent client that reads shared world state, generates its own view, and publishes updated state once per block (Fig. 2 (b)).
Each client runs on its own GPU and combines a video generator G θ G_{\theta} with a state model that estimates position and scene depth from generated video and controls. Only the shared world state is exchanged; activations, KV caches, and intermediate features remain local.
blocks.zh:
为了支持跨机器的可扩展多人视频生成,WorldCast将共享的世界状态和本地渲染分开. 如图2(a)所示,现有的组合设计协调参与者
通过联合多视图生成,通过交叉视图的注意或取景,将玩家的观点一起处理.
WorldCast转而指派每个P玩家一个独立的客户端,读取共享的世界状态,生成自己的视图,每块发布一次更新状态(图2(b)).
每个客户端运行在自己的GPU上,并结合了一台视频生成器G QQQTHETA}和一个状态模型,通过生成的视频和控制来估计位置和场景深度. 只有共享的世界状态被交换;活化,KV缓存,中间特性仍然为局部.

blocks.en: Consistent views require information beyond each client’s recent context. The shared world state therefore comprises two complementary components: player state , a record of each player’s position and attributes (Sec. 3.2 ), and scene state , a memory bank shared by all clients (Sec. 3.3 ). Player state tracks players outside the local view, while scene state preserves observations no longer in the recent context or available only from other clients. Together, these shared states help clients render players and scene appearance consistently across independently generated views.
blocks.zh: 一致的意见需要超越每个客户最近背景的信息。 因此,共享的世界状态由两个互补部分组成:玩家状态,每个玩家位置和属性的记录(Sec.3.2)和场景状态,所有客户共享的记忆库(Sec.3.3. 玩家在本地视图外的状态跟踪玩家,而场景状态保存的观察不再在最近的上下文中,或者只能从其他客户端获取. 这些共享状态共同帮助客户让玩家和场景在独立生成的视图中一致地出现.

After generation, the state model (Sec. 3.4 ) estimates the player’s position and scene depth from the generated latents and controls. The client publishes its updated player state and shares the generated block with its cameras and depth as a new memory entry.

blocks.en: The player state field has a fixed spatial resolution, and each generator reads at most one memory entry, regardless of the player count. Additional players can therefore be served by adding clients without enlarging each generator’s attention sequence.

blocks.en: 3.2 Shared Player State
blocks.zh: 3.2 共享玩家状态

blocks.en: Attributes and update. The shared player state contains one record 𝐬 n i \mathbf{s}^{i}_{n} for each player i i at block n n , describing its position and other attributes, such as facing direction, controls, and weapon. Each record is updated and published only by that player’s client. The position is estimated from generated video and controls by the state model (Sec. 3.4 ), while other attributes are obtained from the player’s inputs. These records provide a common reference for rendering players across clients.
blocks.zh: 属性与更新. 共享玩家状态包含一个记录 s n i \ mathbf{ s}^{i}_{n} 每一个玩家 i 在 n 块 n 时, 描述其位置和其他属性, 如面对方向, 控制和武器. 每张唱片仅由玩家客户端更新并发布. 位置通过由状态模型生成的视频和控制(Sec. 3.4)进行估计,而其他属性则取自玩家的输入. 这些记录为让玩家跨客户端提供共同的参考.

blocks.en:
Camera-aligned player state field. Player states are expressed in world coordinates, whereas the generator operates on image tokens. The state injector bridges these representations by projecting other players into the observing client’s camera and encoding their attributes at the corresponding token locations.
Specifically, for each latent frame f f , it constructs a player state field 𝐅 n , f i \mathbf{F}_{n,f}^{i} on the generator’s token grid.
Each player within the view frustum and visible (Sec. 3.4 ) is projected into the observer’s camera and splatted with a Gaussian kernel ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . The field encodes coverage, camera-relative depth and facing direction, and gameplay attributes such as team, identity, weapon, and controls. Contributions from overlapping players are combined according to their spatial weights and depths (Appendix F ). This gives the generator explicit spatial guidance about where other players should appear and which attributes to render.
blocks.zh:
相机对接的玩家状态场. 玩家状态以世界坐标表示,而生成器则以图像符号来操作. 状态注入器通过将其他玩家投射到观测客户端的相机中,并在相应的符号位置编码其属性来连接这些表示.
具体地说,对于每个潜在框架 f f , 它会构造一个玩家状态场 F n, f i\ mathbf{F}_{n, f}^{i} 在生成器的标志网格上 。
每个在外观中并可见(第3.4节)的玩家被投射到观察者的相机上并被高斯内核(Wang等,2025年)所镀. 球场编码覆盖度,相机相接深度和面对方向,以及团队,身份,武器等游戏玩法属性和控制等. 重叠玩家的贡献根据其空间权重和深度进行组合(Appendix F. 这使得生成器有清晰的空间指导,说明其他玩家应在哪里出现,以及哪些属性可以渲染.

blocks.en: 3.3 Shared Scene State
blocks.zh: 3.3 共享的场景状态

blocks.en: Scene state composition. Shared scene state allows clients to reuse generated observations of the environment, helping maintain consistent scene appearance across views. It is represented as a memory bank, where each entry stores a block of latent frames generated by one client, together with their camera poses and coarse depth maps estimated by the state model (Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 场景状态构成. 共享的场景状态允许客户端再利用生成的环境观测,有助于保持场景在视图间的一致性. 它作为一个内存库来代表,每个条目存储一个客户端生成的一组潜在帧,连同其相机外观和由状态模型估计的粗深图(Sec.3.4.

blocks.en: Scene memory update. Each client publishes every generated block as a new memory entry and maintains at most B B of its own entries. When this capacity is exceeded, it withdraws the most redundant entry—the one whose content is best covered by the client’s other entries under reprojection (Appendix E ). Each entry therefore has a single owner responsible for its publication and removal, while remaining accessible to all clients.
blocks.zh: 场景记忆更新. 每个客户端将每个生成的块作为新的内存条目发布,并最多维持自己的条目B. 当超过此容量时,它会取出最冗余的条目——其内容最好由客户端在再预测下的其他条目所覆盖的条目(附录 E.). 因此,每个条目都有一个所有人负责其出版和删除,同时所有客户都可以使用。

blocks.en: Scene memory retrieval. Before generating block n n , client i i retrieves the memory entry 𝐌 n i \mathbf{M}_{n}^{i} that best covers scene content missing from its recent context. It first back-projects the recent latent frames into 3D and projects these points into the cameras of the upcoming block. Pixels reached by none of these points are treated as missing. The client then projects the points of all memory entries into the same cameras. At each missing pixel, the nearest projected point to the camera defines the reference surface depth. An entry covers that pixel if one of its points lies within a depth tolerance of this surface, preventing occluded content from contributing to its coverage score. The client retrieves the entry covering the most missing pixels, or none if no entry covers any.
blocks.zh: 场景内存检索. 在生成块 n 之前, 客户端 i 检索到内存条目 M n i\ mathbf{ M}_{n}^{i} , 最好覆盖最近上下文中缺失的场景内容 。 它首先将最近的潜伏框架 投放到3D 并将这些点投放到即将到来的区块的相机中 这些点所达到的像素均被视为缺失. 客户端然后将所有内存条目的点投影到同一个相机中. 在每一个缺失的像素上,相机最近的预计点定义了参考地表深度. 一个条目覆盖了这个像素,如果它的一个点位于这个地表的深度耐受度范围内,阻止了被吞噬的内容对它的覆盖分数作出贡献. 客户端检索到覆盖最缺失像素的条目,如果没有条目覆盖任何像素则无.

blocks.en: 3.4 The State Model
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 国家模式

blocks.en: The shared player and scene states require positions and geometry that correspond to the generated world. At inference, these quantities are not supplied by a game engine. Each client therefore uses a state model to estimate its own position and scene depth from generated latents and controls (Fig. 3 , right). Position estimates update the shared player state, while depth estimates support scene memory retrieval and player visibility.
blocks.zh: 共享玩家和场景状态需要与所生成的世界对应的位置和几何. 推断这些数量不是由游戏引擎提供的. 因此,每个客户端都使用一个状态模型从生成的潜伏和控件(图3,右)来估计自己的位置和场景深度. 位置估计更新共享玩家状态,而深度估计则支持场景内存检索和玩家能见度.

blocks.en:
State model architecture. As shown in Fig. 3 right, a convolutional encoder maps each latent frame to a token, an action encoder adds the corresponding control embedding, and a causal transformer processes the resulting sequence.
A motion head predicts the player’s displacement between consecutive latent frames. A place head provides an absolute position estimate on the current map by classifying the frame into a map cell and predicting its offset within the cell (Appendix A ). A separate depth head predicts a coarse depth map from the generated latents.
blocks.zh:
国家示范建筑. 如图. 3右图所示,一个分解编码器将每个潜在框架映射到一个符号上,一个动作编码器会添加相应的控制嵌入,一个因果变压器会处理所形成的序列.
一个运动头可以预测玩家在相接的潜伏框间的位置. 一个位置头通过将帧分解为映射单元格,并预测其在单元格内的抵消(Appendix A.),提供了当前地图上的绝对位置估计. 一个单独的深度头从生成的潜伏物中预测出粗细的深度图.

blocks.en:
Position estimation. The motion head captures displacement from changes in the generated frames, including stops at obstacles, but integrating its displacements accumulates error. The place head provides a map-based reference, including height, but can occasionally mis-localize a frame. We combine their estimates with a complementary filter: 𝐩 f = 1 2 ​ ( 𝐩 f − 1 + 𝚫 f ) + 1 2 ​ 𝐀 f , \mathbf{p}_{f}=\tfrac{1}{2}\,(\mathbf{p}_{f-1}+\bm{\Delta}_{f})+\tfrac{1}{2}\,\mathbf{A}_{f}, (4) where 𝐩 f \mathbf{p}_{f} is the position estimate at latent frame f f , 𝚫 f \bm{\Delta}_{f} is the motion-head displacement, and 𝐀 f \mathbf{A}_{f} is the place-head estimate, which is the offset to start at the given initial position 𝐩 0 \mathbf{p}_{0} .
After each completed block, the client publishes the position estimates, together with its other attributes, as the updated player state.
Before generating the next block, each client extrapolates its camera poses and other players’ positions from their latest published player states by integrating movement and view controls, as networked games do between server updates ( Bernier, 2001 ) . These predictions guide player state field construction and scene memory retrieval. Since extrapolation ignores collisions and terrain height, it may diverge from the motion depicted in the generated video. Therefore, once the block is complete, the state model uses the new frames and Eq. ( 4 ) to correct the client’s own position for the next state update.

在生成下个块之前,每个客户端通过整合移动和取景控制,从最新公布的玩家状态中推断出其相机外观和其他玩家的位置,就像网络游戏在服务器更新之间所做的那样(Bernier, 2001). 这些预测指导了玩家的状态场地构造和场景内存检索. 由于外推忽略了相撞和地形高度,它可能与所生成的视频所描绘的运动相去甚远. 因此,当块完成后,状态模型会使用新的帧和Eq. (4)来纠正客户自身在下一次状态更新时的立场.

blocks.en:
Depth and visibility. The predicted depth maps and camera poses back-project generated observations into 3D points in a common map coordinate system. These points support both scene memory retrieval (Sec. 3.3 ) and visibility gating for the player state field (Sec. 3.2 ).
Before generation, the client projects points from its recent context into the cameras of the upcoming block. Their depths determine whether other players are occluded: a player is considered visible when context points
reach its projection
and their depth lies no more than a fixed margin in front of it (Appendix F ). Since the context may not cover newly exposed regions, the depth head processes the clean estimate 𝐱 ^ 0 \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0} after the first denoising step. This depth updates visibility for the remaining steps.

到达其预测

blocks.en: State model training. The motion and place heads are supervised with recorded player positions, and the depth head is supervised with depth maps rendered from the game’s public 3D map assets. These supervision targets are used only in training (Appendix A ).

blocks.en: 3.5 Training and Inference
blocks.zh: 3.5 培训和推断

blocks.en:
Training stages. We train G θ G_{\theta} in four stages (Appendix Fig. 8 ). Stage 1 fine-tunes a pretrained video diffusion model on Counter-Strike 2 with bidirectional attention on short clips.
Stage 2 conditions G θ G_{\theta} on the shared world state, adding the player state field, then scene state.
Player states are GT states taken from recorded matches, and visibility labels are computed from the game’s public 3D map assets. Memory frames are GT frames of one block from another player’s view in the same round, selected to cover what the recent context misses (Appendix E ).
Stages 3 and 4 make generation real-time: stage 3 converts G θ G_{\theta} to block-causal attention ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) through teacher forcing, and stage 4 distills it to a four-step generator by distribution matching ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2024b ) , trained on its own rollouts to reduce accumulated error ( Huang et al., 2025b ) .

blocks.en: Bidirectional Model Results and Comparisons. We compare against Solaris ( Savva et al., 2026 ) , which uses joint cross-view attention, and frame concatenation. For a controlled comparison, we retrain both with the same backbone, training data, budget, and GT player positions. Our bidirectional model uses only shared player state in this comparison. As shown in Table 2 , WorldCast outperforms both baselines across all reported metrics. Its player rendering rate reaches 0.817, compared with 0.056 for Solaris and 0.074 for frame concatenation, while its unmatched rate falls to 0.039. These gains demonstrate more accurate player placement alongside improved video quality (also shown in Fig. 4 ).

After each block, it publishes its estimated position, renders other players at their published positions, and adds the block to the scene state. blocks.en: In the player state field (Table 5 ), camera alignment matters most: without it, the render rate falls to that of joint generation, and every other retrained variant also lowers it; disabling the visibility test at inference draws occluded players and raises the unmatched rate. For the scene state, retrieving any client’s best-covering entry (our method) achieves the best results after 30 s (Table 3 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en: WorldCast explores a world model as the engine of a networked game, in which each client generates one player’s view on its own GPU and clients exchange only the shared world state. Our method attains a player rendering rate over an order of magnitude higher than joint generation, and scene state improves whole-round consistency. The main limitation is the state model’s position error on generated video, which grows with time (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: WorldCast探索了作为网络游戏引擎的世界模式,其中每个客户端在自己的GPU上生成一个玩家的视图,客户端只交换共享的世界状态. 我们的方法实现了玩家渲染速率,其数量顺序高于联合生成,场景状态提高了全方位的一致性. 主要限制是状态模型在生成的视频上的位置出错,这些视频随时间而增长(Appendix G.

blocks.en: This appendix details the state model of Sec. 3.4 . Its motion head predicts the player’s displacement between consecutive latent frames, its place head recognizes where on the map a frame was taken, and the complementary filter of Eq. ( 4 ) advances one estimate by the former and corrects it with the latter.
blocks.zh: 本附录详细介绍了Sec的状态模型. 3.4 (中文(简体) ). 它的运动头可以预测玩家在相接的潜伏相框之间的迁移,其位置头可以识别图上取出一个相框的位置,而Eq. (4)的互补滤波器可以推进前者的一个估计,并与后者修正.

blocks.en: The state model reads windows of 41 noise-free latent frames ( 48 × 24 × 42 48\times 24\times 42 ) of the client’s own video; one latent frame spans four video frames at 16 fps, or sixteen engine ticks. Five convolutional blocks (three strided) map each latent frame from 48 to 512 channels, and a linear projection yields a token of width 1280. A causal transformer trunk (16 layers, 16 heads, pre-norm, 4 × 4\times feed-forward) processes these tokens, and a linear motion head on its outputs predicts the three-dimensional displacement. The sixteen control values per tick (thirteen buttons, pitch and yaw deltas, a validity flag) are projected to 256 dimensions, encoded by the action encoder (a four-layer causal transformer) and added to the trunk tokens. The place head takes detached trunk tokens, a pooled early feature map, and the unpooled 12 × 21 12\times 21 grid, concatenates a map embedding, and outputs an address (below). The trunk and action encoder have 338 338 M parameters and the motion and place heads 11 11 M.
blocks.zh: 状态模型读取41个无噪声潜伏帧(48×24×42 48\times 24\times 42)的窗口, 从48道到512道的每个潜在相框上都绘制出5个演化区块(3个相接地块),线性投影产生宽度为1280的符号. 一个因果变压器干线(16层,16个头,预规范,4×4\times feed-ward)处理这些活化物,其输出物上的线性运动头会预测出三维相位. 每滴16个控制值(13个按钮,发音和yaw deltas,一个有效性旗)被预测为256个维度,由动作编码器(一个四层因果变压器)编码并添加到干线活字上. 地头取出脱落的干线活符,集合的早期地物图,和被脱落的12×21 12\times 21格,将地图嵌入,输出出地址(下方). 干线和动作编码器有338个338 M参数,运动并放置了11 M头.

blocks.en: Positions are in the game engine’s unit of length, u (not the token index u u of Appendix F ); a player’s body is 32 u ( 0.61 0.61 m) wide. To predict position as a class, each map is tiled into cells of 256 × 256 × 64 256\times 256\times 64 u, each divided 4 × 4 × 1 4\times 4\times 1 into sub-cells; a cell, a sub-cell, and an offset of at most ± 32 \pm 32 u from the sub-cell center represent a position exactly. The place head predicts the cell, then the sub-cell conditioned on the cell’s 64-dimensional embedding, then the offset through a tanh. A map has at most 8,768 8{,}768 sub-cells in its occupied cells.
blocks.zh: 位置位于游戏引擎的长度单位u(不是附录F的符号索引u;玩家身体为32 u (0.61 0.61 m)宽. 要预测作为一个类的位置,每张地圖被打入256×256×64 256\times 256\times 64 u的细胞中,每张地圖将4×4×1 4\times 4\times 1分为子细胞;一个细胞,一个子细胞,和一个从子细胞中心到最多±32\pm 32 u的相抵,代表着一个准确的位置. 地点头会预测细胞,然后子细胞以细胞的64维嵌入为条件,再通过tunh来抵消. 地图在其被占用的细胞中最多有8,768个8{,}768个子细胞.

blocks.en: Eq. ( 4 ), used for all results with predicted states, weights the integrated position and the place head’s estimate equally at every latent frame and has no learned parameters. The estimate is initialized at the player’s GT position at the start of the round (or of the window, for ten-second windows). The place head’s estimates enter as displacements from its first estimate, so its constant bias cancels.

blocks.en: As in networked games, each client extrapolates the motion of all players locally and is authoritative for its own player. The cameras of a block’s four latent frames and the other players’ positions over it are extrapolated from the controls ( Bernier, 2001 ) , since the block has no frames yet. Clients exchange player state once per block (Sec. 3.1 ); with predicted states, block n n starts from the positions published when it begins, each player’s estimate at the last latent frame of block n − 1 n-1 . Each player’s movement keys are integrated at 64 Hz with per-key walking speeds, without collisions, and the facing direction accumulates the view controls from the last known facing direction. After the block, each client corrects only its own player’s position, with the state model and Eq. ( 4 ) on its new frames, and publishes it; every client then extrapolates over the next block from these corrected positions. With GT states, the GT cameras and positions are used.
blocks.zh: 和网络游戏一样,每个客户端都会在当地推断出所有玩家的动作,并对自己的玩家具有权威性. 一个街区的4个潜在框架的相机和其他玩家在它上面的位置是从控制器中推断出来的(Bernier,2001年),因为该街区还没有帧. 客户端每块一次交换玩家状态(Sec. 3.1);有预测状态,n块从开始时公布的位置开始,每个玩家在n-1n-1块的最后一个潜在框架上的估计. 每个玩家的运动键被集成为64Hz,每键行走速度不相撞,而相向方向会从最后已知的相向方向累积取景控制. 在块后,每个客户端只纠正自己的玩家位置,在新框上加上状态模型和Eq. blocks.en: The depth head, a separate 44 44 M-parameter residual network with ten blocks at width 384 and a five-block half-resolution branch, predicts the depth-video latent of the client’s own view from three latent frames of context (generated at inference), supervised offline by depth rendered from the public 3D map assets. A 0.21 0.21 M-parameter read-out maps this latent, without VAE decoding, to one depth value per 16 × 16 16\times 16 pixel patch, on which visibility (Sec. 3.4 ) is computed; Fig. 5 shows the prediction decoded at full resolution on a recorded frame. The map assets contain no players, so the depth excludes occlusion between players. On held-out recorded frames of the clients of Table 19 , the read-out depth differs from the rendered map depth by a median factor of 1.07 1.07 , with 85 % 85\% of patches within a factor of 1.25 1.25 . blocks.en: Every client, once per block, publishes one message and reads the latest message of every other client, without a central process that merges them. For block n n , client j j (i) publishes its player state 𝐬 n j \mathbf{s}^{j}_{n} , that is, the positions that Eq. ( 4 ) estimates at the four latent frames of block n − 1 n-1 , the facing direction, and the controls and weapon for block n n ; with scene state, also block n − 1 n-1 as a memory entry (four cameras and depths) and the memory entries it withdraws; and (ii) generates block n n : it extrapolates the other players from their latest player states over the block (Appendix A ), applies the withdrawals and retrieves at most one memory entry completed before block n n , whose latents it fetches from the client that generated it. A message takes 3.7 3.7 kB for the player state and 8.3 8.3 kB for a memory entry (cameras in single precision, a 4 × 24 × 42 4\times 24\times 42 depth in half precision); fetching the latents of a memory entry takes 387 387 kB. With GT states, player states come from the recording, and messages carry only the scene state. In our evaluations, each client runs on its own GPU, messages and latents are exchanged through a shared file system (for the timings of Table 7 with P ≤ 8 P\leq 8 , through shared memory on one machine), and the clients advance in lockstep, so that every client reads the messages of the same block.

blocks.en: The training cost of WorldCast does not depend on P P , since a sample is always the window of one player: under teacher forcing, 41 context and 41 noisy latent frames, or, when the sample holds memory frames, the shorter window of Appendix E . A joint-generation method must place all players in one sample, 82 ​ P 82P frames for the same model. On one H200, with frozen parameters and gradient checkpointing, a forward and backward pass over one sample takes 11.3 GiB beyond the 10.8 GiB of weights for 82 frames, 22.5 GiB for 164, 64.7 GiB for 328 and 100.9 GiB for 410, and runs out of memory for 656. Stage 4 runs 600 steps at a global batch of 64 ten-second windows, updating the generator every fifth step and the critic otherwise. The generator is initialized from the stage-3 model, and the teacher and critic from WorldCast , the stage-2 model at 25,000 steps (Table 2 ), which has no scene state. From the recorded first frame, the generator produces the other 40 latent frames of each window as ten blocks of four, each conditioned on its own earlier outputs; the teacher and critic score the whole window bidirectionally. blocks.en: The two baselines keep jointly generated views consistent through attention between them; they receive the player states as tokens, in training and at inference, so that they know where the other players are, as the field does; the comparison is between joint generation and the player state field, not between ways of feeding states. Each player’s state enters as one token per latent frame, with the token contents of the model trained without camera alignment (Appendix F ) and the GT visibility label, folded per latent frame as for the field. The tokens join the cross-attention context, their mean over players is added to the frame’s action modulation, and training uses the uniform loss.
blocks.zh: 这两个基线通过它们之间的关注来保持共同生成的观点的一致性;它们接收玩家状态作为象征,在训练中和在推断中,让他们知道其他玩家的位置,就像球场一样;比较是联合生成和玩家状态场,而不是喂食状态的方法. 每个玩家的状态作为每个潜在框架的一个符号输入,模型的标志性内容在不相机对接(Appendix F)和GT能见度标签的情况下训练,每个潜在框架与球场一样折叠. 指使会加入交叉注意的上下文,他们的对玩家的恶性被加入到帧的动作调制中,而训练会使用统一损失.

blocks.en: Every model that receives the states as tokens, coupled or not, renders below 0.1 0.1 , against 0.763 0.763 for WorldCast at the same 384k windows: the model trained without camera alignment (Table 5 ), a single view given the states as tokens, renders 0.093 0.093 , against 0.074 0.074 for frame concatenation and 0.056 0.056 for Solaris at 1.6M windows (Table 2 ). We attribute the gap to where the state enters. The state injector writes each player’s state explicitly, aligned with the camera, at the tokens where the player appears, so that the pretrained DiT can draw the player there; attention between views must learn this placement implicitly and, at these budgets, does not. The model trained without camera alignment differs from the baselines in three further ways: it has the foreground weight, lacks the visibility label and sees 384k windows. Nor does the budget explain the gap: the baselines stay below 0.09 0.09 at every budget, including 256k and 512k on either side of 384k, whereas WorldCast renders 0.62 0.62 of the other players at 64k windows and improves with data (Table 9 ).
blocks.zh: 每一个接受这些状态作为标志的模型,无论是否加在一起,都使0.1以下,而世界0.763 0.763 在同一384克窗口进行铸造:在没有相机相接的情况下训练的模型(表5),作为符号的单视图,使0.093 0.093,而框架接合0.074 0.074,索拉里斯在1.6M窗口上的0.056 0.056(表2)。 我们把差距归结为国家进入的地方。 状态注入器将每个玩家的状态明确写出,与相机对齐,在玩家出现地的符号上,这样预先训练的DiT就可以将玩家吸引到那里去;观点之间的注意力必须隐含地学习这个位置,在这些预算上是不会的. 不相机对接而训练的模型在三个方面与基线不同:它具有前地重量,缺乏能见度标签并看到384k窗口. 预算也没有解释差距:每个预算的基线都低于0.090.09,包括384k两侧的256k和512k,而WorldCast在64k窗口使其他玩家的0.620.62分,并随着数据改善(表9).

blocks.en: Both sets are drawn from the 1,373 rounds of the 40 held-out matches by rules fixed before any reported result and based only on the recordings and the map assets: the visibility labels computed from them, which players’ first-person views the dataset holds, and the length of each recording. The set of ten-second windows takes 64 rounds per map, 256 in total, in a seeded random order and, in each, the ten-second window, among windows starting every 2.5 s, and the pair of players with a first-person view of it that maximize the smaller of the two shares of frames in which one player has the other in view. These two players give the two generated views, the pair that the joint-generation methods generate together; this smaller share ranges from 16% to 100% (median 48%), and windows start a median of 23 s into the round. The whole-round set scores each group of three players whose recordings all last at least 60 s by the share of seconds in which one player has another in view in at least half of the frames, averaged over its two pairs with the highest shares and multiplied by the rollout length capped at 120 s; it keeps the eight rounds per map with the best-scoring groups. Although the rule does not require one team, in all 32 rounds the three selected players are teammates who remain alive throughout their rollouts, which run from the round start to the end of the shortest recording (67 to 120 s). All methods and ablations use the same windows and rounds.
blocks.zh: 两套都取自于在任何报告结果之前所设定的40个被搁置的比赛规则中的1 373个回合,仅取自录音和地图资产:从这些记录中计算出的能见度标签,玩家第一人称查看数据集所持有的能见度标签,以及每次录制的长度。 一套十秒窗口每张地图需要64发,共256发,按种子随机顺序排列,每张10秒窗口,从每2.5 s起的窗口之间,以及一对第一人称视图的玩家,可以使一个玩家所查看的两股帧中较小的部分最大化. 这两个玩家给出了两个生成的视图,联合生成方法共同生成的对;这个更小的份额从16%到100%(中位数为48%),窗口从中位数23 s入围. 全回合制每组3名球员的录制时间至少为60分之1秒,其中一名球员在至少一半的帧内有另一名球员观看时,每组的录制时间平均为其两对分数最高的球员的分数,并乘以滚出时的长度以120 s为上限;它保持了每张地图上8发与得分最高的组别. 虽然规则不需要一支球队,但在所有32轮比赛中,被选中的三名球员都是队友,他们在整个出道期间依然活活生生,从出道起一直持续到最短的录制结束(67到120 s). 所有的方法和活化都使用同样的窗口和圆弹.

blocks.en: Rendered and Unmatched are computed in all tables with the rule of Sec. 4 , against the state given to the generator (with GT states, the recorded position and the visibility computed from the map assets). A pair of another player and a frame is scored if the player is marked visible in the state given to the generator, the player’s box clipped to the 384 × 672 384\times 672 frame covers at least 24 2 24^{2} pixels, and the detector finds the player in the recorded video; the player is rendered if a person is detected within one body width, the width of the player’s projected box, of its position in the given player state, each detected person matching at most one player. A detected person is unmatched if neither a player marked visible in the given state, with a projected box at least 24 pixels on its short side, nor a person detected in the recorded video lies within one body width of it; the unmatched rate is the unmatched share of persons detected in the generated frames. Both rates are computed for each view, one player’s view of a ten-second window, with a whole round split into consecutive ten-second windows, and are summarized by their median over the views with at least eight pairs or eight detected persons, respectively; the views in the unmatched median thus depend on how many persons a generator draws and can differ between rows. blocks.en: Each ablation changes one aspect of WorldCast on the same rounds. blocks.en: All clients share one scene state per round. A memory entry is one block (four latent frames, one second of video), stored with each latent frame’s camera and the depth predicted by the depth head from the block’s own latents, one value per 16 × 16 16\times 16 -pixel patch (Sec. 3.4 ). Each latent frame spans four video frames and takes the camera and depth of the last, when its content is complete and the state model reads its position. A set of memory entries covers a pixel of a frame if the nearest of their reprojected points matches the frame’s depth there within the larger of 24 24 u and 5 % 5\% . Every generated block is published as a memory entry; each client keeps at most B = 64 B=64 of its own, withdrawing beyond this bound the one best covered by its others (the older on a tie). With reprojections between a client’s memory entries cached, publishing adds at most 2 ​ B 2B reprojections and withdrawal requires none. The scene state thus holds at most B B memory entries per client for any rollout length, and B ​ P BP for P P clients. Retrieval projects every memory entry completed before a block, so its per-block cost grows with the number of memory entries, at most linearly in P P , unlike the generator’s; the frame rates of Table 7 include it.
blocks.zh: 所有客户每回合共享一个场景状态. 一个内存条目是一个块(四个潜在帧,一秒钟视频),与每个潜在帧相机一起存储,深度头从块自身潜入中预言的深度,每16×16 16\times 16-像素补丁一个值(第3.4节). 每个潜在框架跨出四个视频框架,取上个框架的相机和深度,当其内容完整,状态模型读取其位置时. 一组内存条目覆盖一个框架的像素,如果它们重新预测的点中最接近的点与24个24u和5%=====的框深度相匹配。 每个生成的块被作为内存条目发布;每个客户端最多保留了自己的B = 64 B = 64,从此后撤出其他块所覆盖的最优(平分的上等). 随着客户端内存条目之间的再预测被缓存,出版最多增加了2个B 2B再预测,撤回则不需要。 因此,场景状态在任何推出长度的每个客户端最多持有B B内存条目,在P P客户端最多持有B B. 检索每个在块前完成的内存条目的项目,因此其每块的成本随着内存条目数的增加而增加,最多是线性地在PP中,与生成器不同;表7的帧率包括了它.

blocks.en: Retrieval runs before the first denoising step, when the block has no frames, and so uses only its four cameras and its missing pixels, which no 3D point of the client’s twelve most recent latent frames reaches. A memory entry covers a missing pixel if its point lies, within the tolerance, on the visible surface given by the nearest point of any memory entry. Of all memory entries completed before the block, the client’s own included, the one covering the most missing pixels is retrieved (the more recent on a tie), and none if no memory entry covers any. Retrieving at most one memory entry bounds the generator’s input at twenty latent frames (four memory frames, twelve recent context frames, four target frames) for any number of clients. In the rollouts of Table 3 , a memory entry is retrieved for 95 % 95\% of the blocks that read the scene state, 0.65 0.65 [ 0.61 , 0.68 ] [0.61,0.68] of them from the other two clients; in the closed-loop deployment of Table 4 a, for 96 % 96\% , 0.47 0.47 [ 0.44 , 0.50 ] [0.44,0.50] of them from the other clients. blocks.en: The whole-round results of Tables 3 , 15 , 16 , 17 and 18 and of the upper part of Table 19 give every client the GT states of all players, to measure the generator and the scene state separately from the predicted states (Appendix D ). Table 4 a and the lower part of Table 19 use closed-loop deployment, with predicted states. With predicted states (Tables 2 and 4 a), the entity criterion scores each generated frame against the positions and visibility given to the generator, that is, whether each player is drawn where that player’s own client has placed it. Every rollout departs from the recording as its errors accumulate, so the criterion asks whether the clients agree on one world, kept shared by the predicted states and, in Table 4 a, the scene state, rather than whether that world follows the recording. On video generated with GT states, the state model’s median position error against the GT trajectory grows to 2.64 2.64 body widths at 50 50 – 60 60 s, and 39 % 39\% of clients are within two body widths at 60 60 s (Table 6 ).

blocks.en: Rendered counts a player as drawn when the fine-tuned detector finds a person within one body width of its position in the given player state; Unmatched counts detections with no such player nearby and no person detected nearby in the recorded video. Neither checks the team, identity, facing direction, weapon or controls that the field also carries; both inherit the detector’s errors, and only players that the detector finds in the recorded video are scored for Rendered, so those it misses there are not evaluated (Sec. 4 ).

blocks.en: In our evaluations, clients advance in lockstep, one block at a time (Sec. 3.1 ); the evaluations and timing measurements (Appendix B ) vary neither network delay, jitter nor loss, and do not study clients that fall behind. Within a block, a client extrapolates the other players’ latest published positions from their controls (Appendix A ); the effect of staleness on rendering is not measured. Player states and memory entries from other clients are used as received, without cross-checking, so a faulty client alters what the others render.
blocks.zh: 在我们的评价中,客户一步一步地前进(第3.1节);评价和时间测量(附录B)既不不同网络延迟、紧张也不不同,不研究落后的客户。 在块内,一个客户端从其控制中推断出其他玩家最新公布的位置(Appendix A ;对渲染的停滞效果没有测量. 玩家状态和其他客户端的内存条目按实收使用,不进行交叉检查,因此一个有错的客户端会改变其他客户端的渲染.

blocks.en: Every client starts from recorded first frames and its GT position (Appendices A and D ).
